sourceSentences: The fissure stops at maximum range or 200 units behind the first enemy champion struck. After a 1.125-second delay, a magma pillar then erupts at the location to knock aside enemies, though not through terrain, and linger as impassible terrain for 4 seconds.
The pillar will not expire during Searing Charge dash.
If launched in a wall, pillar will try to appear on the other side of the wall, if it cannot the pillar will be destroyed.
Ornn marches forward in the target direction over 0.75 seconds, gaining displacement immunity and becoming unable to act for the duration.
The final gout of flame can reach slightly farther and will apply Brittle for 3 seconds.
Bellows Breath's lunge can pass over thin, player-generated terrain (i.e R) but will otherwise not be able to.
If Ornn collides with terrain during the charge, he creates a shockwave that knocks up and stuns nearby enemies for 1.25 seconds and deals the same damage if they were not already hit by the charge.
The shockwave destroys the pillar formed by Volcanic Rupture and partially destroys terrain created by enemy champions.
Searing Charge can interact with player-generated terrain.

Ornn's and allies' immobilizing effects or silences against Brittle enemies will consume the debuff to deal bonus magic damage equal to % of the target's maximum health, and cause the crowd control to last 30% longer (if applicable).
His basic attacks on-hit against enemies afflicted with Brittle are empowered to knock them back a short distance over 0.4 seconds.
Call of the Forge God cannot be recast while grounded or rooted.
Once Ornn attempts to purchase an item, he starts forging it, causing him to channel for 4 seconds. The channel is interrupted if Ornn takes damage from enemy champions or turrets.
The second combo is W auto Q combo. This is a very basic way to trade in lane. You can Q first if you want to or you can use the Q ability after.
The third combo is QE auto combo. It's important you auto attack between some of the abilities so it can deal more damage.
The fourth combo is the QR into ERW auto combo. This is a very advanced combo which lets you again maximize your damage but this time with your alt and it's a great way to start a fight.
For combos, you'll go into his W into Q before attacking into E and attacking into W.
And a funnel in is to Q into your ultimate and W. From here, attack into ulting again to proc brittle twice, and then attack into E before attacking away.
if you put your Q in a good position you can also use that with E to engage
